name: Lindsey Wise
reason: Too thin: her own site (shamamawise.com, robots.txt allows us) has a contact form and a session booking link, but its Sessions page returns 404, every event listed has already passed (latest 22 Jul 2026), and it links no YouTube channel, books or free practices, so fewer than three items could be found. Her recent events also lean on plant-medicine work (an online Bobinsana dieta, 'magical chocolates', integration circles; she was a guest on The Mama Psychedelia Podcast), which would need the owner's view under the psychedelic rule. Her events page names The Shift Network (a 2024 Peru journey with Puma she supported).
